(()=>{const l=document.getElementById('landing'); if(l) l.remove(); scrollTo(0,0); runNow(true); return 1})()

(()=>{const d=document.getElementById('report-dialog'); const n=d.querySelector('.strategy-create-form input[type=text]'); n.value='Mon portefeuille'; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const l=[...d.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='DEUIDXEUR'); l.setAttribute('data-freeze','deu'); const i=l.querySelector('input'); i.click(); n.setAttribute('data-freeze','name'); return i.checked})()

(()=>{const a=((t)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#settings .settings-section')].find(x=>x.querySelector(':scope>summary')?.textContent.trim()===t))('Allocation initiale'); a.open=false; const ai=document.querySelector('#settings .settings-ai'); ai.open=true; return 1})()
